title: Migrate Kanbus-web (deploy on the standard front end) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code migrated, not deployed (no hosting). Kanbus-web PR #2 (merged): web/projection.json + web/hooks.py replace web/projector.py (565) and reader/build.py (127) (-692; +243 hooks, +33 settings). Needed core additions (Papyrus 5.1.0): section introduction above listing + sort by order (PR #413), body_class hook, --from-dir (PR #408). Parity old build vs new, 87 URLs: 0 blocking, DOM identical on 71 pages. Hosting missing in kanbus-production (494166748521): only github-oidc-provider and CDKToolkit stacks exist; no Amplify CMS app, no kanbus-web-infra pipeline, no CloudFront/bucket, no hosted zone; kanb.us zone Z01800091FUWW7R6GS7GV is in the legacy account (authoritative per dig NS). Needs (README Deploy): deploy infra/pipeline stack, approve the GitHub connection, Google OAuth secrets for the CMS, import content, then the kanb.us zone move and Amplify domain detach in legacy, then alias/ACM on the distribution.
